Iron Maiden

Country of origin:
United Kingdom
Location:
London, England
Status:
Active
Formed in:
1975
Genre:
Heavy Metal, NWOBHM
Themes:
Literature, History, Life, Death, War, Mythology, Society, Religion, Science fiction
Current label:
Parlophone
Years active:
1975-present
In late 1975 Iron Maiden's lineup consisted of bassist Steve Harris, guitarists Dave Sullivan and Terry Rance, drummer Ron "Rebel" Matthews, and vocalist Paul Mario Day. Day, who the rest of the band felt lacked stage presence, was soon replaced by Dennis Wilcock.
